Class Lobby

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am02.server.controller.Lobby
public class Lobby extends Object
Represents a pre-game lobby in which players gather before the match starts.

A lobby is created by ControllerManager and holds up to expectedPlayers clients. It tracks nickname selection and totem selection independently. The game starts automatically once every slot is filled with a valid nickname and a chosen totem, via ControllerManager.startGame(String, List, List, Map, Map).

All public methods are synchronized on the lobby's own monitor.

    • Lobby

      public Lobby(String lobbyId, int expectedPlayers, ControllerManager controllerManager)
      Parameters:
      lobbyId - unique identifier for this lobby (reused as the game ID)
      expectedPlayers - total number of players required to start (2–5)
      controllerManager - reference to the singleton controller manager, used to trigger game start and return clients on leave

  • Method Details

    • addClient

      public void addClient(String clientId, VirtualView view)
      Adds a client to the lobby and broadcasts the updated lobby state. No-op if the lobby is already full or has started.
      Parameters:
      clientId - the client's unique identifier
      view - the client's VirtualView

    • requestNickname

      public boolean requestNickname(String clientId, String nickname)
      Processes a nickname request from a client. Rejects the request if the nickname is blank or already taken in this lobby. Triggers checkAndStart() after a successful assignment.
      Parameters:
      clientId - the requesting client
      nickname - the desired nickname
      Returns:
      true if the nickname was accepted, false otherwise

    • selectTotem

      public void selectTotem(String clientId, Totem totem)
      Processes a totem selection from a client. Rejects the request if the client has no nickname yet or the totem is already taken. Triggers checkAndStart() after a successful selection.
      Parameters:
      clientId - the requesting client
      totem - the desired totem colour

    • removeClient

      public void removeClient(String clientId)
      Removes a client from the lobby and returns them to the pre-lobby state. Dissolves the lobby if it becomes empty.
      Parameters:
      clientId - the client leaving the lobby

    • getPlayerCount

      public int getPlayerCount()
      Returns:
      the current number of clients in this lobby
